description: Get the steps to install one Wisty UI item: the shadcn command, and the theme and icon steps it needs. First read style and tailwind.css from the project's components.json, and whether it has a src/ folder; a project without components.json runs npx shadcn@latest init first.

srcDir.description: Whether the project has a src/ folder. Left out, a tailwindCss under src/ means yes.

style.description: The "style" in the project's components.json, like "radix-nova" or "base-nova": it picks the Radix or Base UI version.

tailwindCss.description: The "tailwind.css" path as components.json gives it, like "src/index.css", for the exact theme import lines.

themed.description: True when the stylesheet already has Wisty UI's theme (--color-page in its @theme inline, or a tokens.css import), to leave the theme step out.

name: get_install_command
title: Install a Wisty UI item
